description: This file defines the Days360 class, which provides a method to calculate the number of days between two dates based on a 360-day year, used in some accounting calculations. It includes functions for handling date conversions, date differences, and supports array inputs.

classes.name: Days360
classes.description: Provides methods to calculate the number of days between two dates based on a 360-day year, supporting both U.S. and European methods, with support for array inputs.

methods.name: between
methods.description: Calculates the number of days between two dates based on a 360-day calendar, supporting single values and arrays, with an optional method parameter for U.S. or European calculation style.

methods.name: dateDiff360
methods.description: Calculates the difference in days between two dates on a 360-day calendar, used internally by the between method.

methods.name: getStartDay
methods.description: Adjusts the start day according to the 360-day calculation rules, considering the method used.

methods.name: getEndDay
methods.description: Adjusts the end day according to the 360-day calculation rules, considering the method used.
